interpretation_precommit.aggregation: paired same-fold/same-seed deltas; average the two seeds within fold, then five equally weighted folds; show all seed and fold values
interpretation_precommit.collapse_flags: retain every completed evaluation and flag; no exclusion/rescue
interpretation_precommit.contrast: V1 minus V0, each endpoint and each cohort separately
interpretation_precommit.discordant_cohorts: report cohort-specific results; no general architectural superiority
interpretation_precommit.discordant_tasks: report task-dependent trade-off; no universal winner
interpretation_precommit.five_of_five: descriptively consistent direction in this cohort, not significance or independent replication
interpretation_precommit.mixed_fold_signs: show the mean, median, range and all five deltas; describe heterogeneous fold-level differences
interpretation_precommit.scope: the complete frozen V0-to-V1 architecture/objective transition; private heads, decoder inputs and alignment/orthogonality/private-separation terms differ; not equal-capacity causal decomposition
interpretation_precommit.sign_count: count raw numerical signs; no 4/5 or 5/5 success gate; display zeros separately
interpretation_precommit.small_differences: report exact observed magnitudes; no equivalence/noninferiority claim or new practical margin
interpretation_precommit.technical_failure: stop and preserve error; no seed/parameter rescue and no successful-only primary average

preprocessing.epoch_selection: fit rows only; early rows select epoch only
preprocessing.future_real_digest_check: both preliminary/refit preprocessing fingerprints must match the historical same-fold preprocessing record before V0 fitting
preprocessing.refit: refit preprocessing on all outer-training rows; same-seed reinitialize; selected epoch count
